paper.title: Fast leave-one-cluster-out cross-validation using clustered network information criterion

evidence.paraphrase: Argues that prediction models on clustered data need cluster-based validation and derives a clustered network information criterion approximating leave-one-cluster-out deviance.
Replaces the Fisher information with a clustering-adjusted estimator, penalising more strongly as within-cluster dependence grows.
Focus is model selection in clinical regression rather than comparing ranking systems, so transfer to bag/query dependence needs argument.

reviews.rationale: The paper directly addresses evaluation validity when observations are clustered rather than independent, matching the dependent_inference role's purpose. It is a methods anchor for cluster-aware validation, though its use case is model selection rather than significance testing across resampled bags.

paper.title: Error processing and gender-shared and -specific neural predictors of relapse in cocaine dependence

evidence.paraphrase: fMRI study of error-processing activations predicting relapse in 97 cocaine-dependent individuals, by gender.
'Dependence' refers to drug dependence; resampling is used only to validate regional predictors.

reviews.rationale: The match is driven by the word 'dependence' (cocaine dependence). The paper has no content on statistically dependent evaluation units and is out of scope.

paper.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Early Assessment of COVID-19 Risk Prediction in Emergency Departments

evidence.paraphrase: Explainable random-forest system for COVID-19 risk prediction in emergency departments using Boruta variable selection in 10-fold CV.
Cross-validation is used for variable importance; no dependence among folds or clustered evaluation is addressed.

reviews.rationale: The paper is a domain study unrelated to scholarly search, recommendation or bibliographic evidence selection; its match to the role is lexical. It is out of scope.

paper.title: Importance of regional variation in conservation planning: a rangewide example of the Greater Sage‐Grouse

evidence.paraphrase: Random-forest habitat and population models for Greater Sage-Grouse conservation planning across management zones.
'Clustering' describes spatial clustering of bird abundance; cross-validation statistics are reported without addressing dependence.

reviews.rationale: The paper is a domain study unrelated to scholarly search, recommendation or bibliographic evidence selection; its match to the role is lexical. It is out of scope.

paper.title: An Evolutionary-Network Model Reveals Stratified Interactions in the V3 Loop of the HIV-1 Envelope

evidence.paraphrase: Phylogenetically aware Bayesian graphical model to detect residue interactions in the HIV-1 V3 loop.
Shows that ignoring shared evolutionary history (non-independent sequences) inflates false positives to 20-40%, a conceptual analogue of dependent observations.

reviews.rationale: The paper makes the general point that treating dependent observations as independent inflates false positives, which is analogous to the role's concern, but it is a molecular-evolution study with no evaluation-resampling content. Out of scope; at most a distant analogue.
